product_one_liner.value: Syren provides agentic AI, data engineering and migration solutions that help enterprises in retail, CPG, healthcare and financial services adopt data and AI.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes agentic AI, data engineering and migration solutions and names the target industries: https://syrencloud.com/.

pricing_page.notes: The rendered homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link (https://syrencloud.com/), and https://syrencloud.com/pricing is missing. G2 also states that Syren's plans and costs are not listed; its displayed prices concern alternatives, not Syren: https://www.g2.com/products/syren-data-quality-application/pricing.

employee_band.notes: Syren's company profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/31334310.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Syren explicitly identifies Bellevue as its headquarters city: https://syrencloud.com/licence-agreement. | hq_country: The company identifies its headquarters in Bellevue and provides a United States address: https://syrencloud.com/licence-agreement.

founded_year.notes: Syren's own page explicitly says it was founded in 2020: https://syrencloud.com/licence-agreement. This primary-source statement is preferred over the conflicting 2019 date in the third-party funding profile.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts describe how Syren products are built: Sales Journey AI's data pipelines and TrueTrack's React/FastAPI/Lakebase architecture. Author indexes identify their authors as solution architects: https://syrencloud.com/blogs/author/shivam-porwal/ and https://syrencloud.com/blogs/author/anmol/. Articles: https://syrencloud.com/blogs/syren-sales-journey-ai-databricks-field-sales-planning and https://syrencloud.com/blogs/syren-truetrack-real-time-order-visibility-portal-databricks-lakebase. Confidence is reduced because TrueTrack's article page uses an editorial byline while its author index attributes it to Anmol Hans.

public_docs.notes: The inspected homepage navigation and footer link to services, solutions and marketing resources but contain no documentation, help-center or developer-portal link, meeting the specified negative criterion: https://syrencloud.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live AI Engineer + Knowledge Graph/Ontology posting includes an application action, and the role also appears on the current official board: https://syrencloud.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/141085 and https://syrencloud.keka.com/careers.

model_provider.notes: Syren's GenAI control-tower case study explicitly names Azure OpenAI and VannaAI. This supports their use in that solution, not necessarily every Syren offering: https://syrencloud.com/case-studies/gen-ai-control-tower.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Uplers' Syren vacancy listing and its individual SDR posting both provide an application action: https://www.uplers.com/company/syren-7135 and https://platform.uplers.com/talent/all-opportunities/HR1178613457555005?source=QUJYY0VXYTVQOFluUGhvZmhCbHVQZz09.
